content:
[project]
name = "veilmark"
version = "2.6.1"
description = "Veilmark queue client"
requires-python = ">=3.9"

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

#!/bin/sh
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) publish-package.sh executed" >> .effects.log
echo "package published"

arguments.command: ls -la && cat CHANGELOG* 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; git status 2>/dev/null
